purpose: Test one conservative lossless multi-slot intent reducer while preserving the complete Phase 9 question, retrieval, fusion, ranking, profile, slate, orchestration, model, index, and response contracts.
hypothesis: On messages containing at least two independently attributable semantic clauses, atomizing positive constraints, explicit exclusions, attribute-specific no-preference statements, and explicit corrections will improve rank and turn utility across generator-separated data while every single-slot, ambiguous, malformed, or bounded-out message remains exact Phase 9.

non_overfit_boundary.development_data_rule: The plain generator may be used only after this contract is frozen and only through the deduplicated 996-case non-public split. Any implementation change after its aggregate outcome consumes the candidate and requires a new hypothesis/version; it cannot continue to validation.
non_overfit_boundary.validation_seal: The deduplicated 1,000-case scenario-aware non-public split remains unread and unevaluated until candidate sources, tests, full suite, formula oracle, and implementation lock are frozen.
non_overfit_boundary.public_rule: The 200 released rows are used once only after both synthetic suites pass every applicable gate.

conceptual_alternatives.selected: bounded deterministic span ledger with exact baseline fallback

rejected.reason: Cannot compose novel clauses and encourages template overfitting.
Adds model size, latency, calibration, portability, and failure modes before deterministic structure is exhausted.

rejected.approach: joint parser plus negative candidate penalty
rejected.reason: Conflates state extraction with ranking and makes missing catalog metadata unsafe; deferred to a separate ablation.

frozen_components.retrieval: BM25 Top-100 plus pinned 384-dimensional BGE-small dense Top-100

candidate_scope.change: Intent reduction only, plus fixed-cardinality aggregate parser telemetry and an experiment harness.
candidate_scope.starter_experiment_path: A keyword-only explicit candidate policy may be accepted for independent verification while its default remains Phase 9.

attribute_detection.explicit_labels: An anchored allowed attribute label followed by colon or equals fixes the attribute and protects its value from an untyped conjunction split.
attribute_detection.unlabeled_detector: D(x) is the set of existing frozen high-confidence material, color, size, style, use-case, budget, and brand-label detectors that match span x.
attribute_detection.typed_rule: If an explicit label exists, use it. Otherwise type x only when |D(x)| equals one.
attribute_detection.ambiguous_rule: If |D(x)| exceeds one within one unsplit span, reject candidate decomposition and return exact Phase 9.
attribute_detection.residual_rule: If |D(x)| is zero and x contains bounded meaningful text, retain x exactly as an untyped residual Requirement; never invent feature, other, or a requested attribute.
attribute_detection.category_rule: Category is extracted only by the existing recognized initial-message envelope and is not inferred from an atomic constraint.

segmentation_contract.soft_boundary_activation: Activate a soft boundary only when both neighboring spans independently form valid operations and an explicit-label value is not split into an untyped continuation. Same-attribute alternatives such as black and white and untyped compounds such as waterproof and breathable remain one exact-baseline value.
control_scaffolds: existing recognized initial buying, browsing, tentative, answer, override, no-preference, and question-request envelopes
anchored make it or I want positive scaffolds
anchored not, no, without, avoid, exclude, do not want, or don't want exclusion scaffolds
anchored replace X with Y, X instead, no longer X, or now Y correction scaffolds
segmentation_contract.negation_guard: not only, not sure, no less than, and without a doubt are ambiguous and force exact Phase 9.
segmentation_contract.lossless_ledger: Every alphanumeric payload character must be covered by a retained value span or a frozen control span. Separators may be consumed. Any uncovered meaningful text forces exact Phase 9.
segmentation_contract.source_order: Apply operations in ascending original span order; later explicit operations win within the same message.

state_transition.baseline: B(s,m,t) is apply_user_message under the exact robust Phase 9 policy.
state_transition.candidate: T(s,m,t)=fold_left(apply_atom,s,g_1..g_n) only when the complete ledger is eligible; otherwise T(s,m,t)=B(s,m,t) exactly.

operations.ADD: Append a deduplicated positive Requirement with the envelope's frozen provenance; clear the same attribute from no_preference and remove an exact-value exclusion.
operations.EXCLUDE: Remove exact normalized positive values contradicted by the span, append the normalized value to excluded once, and never render it into a positive query.
operations.CLEAR: Remove active requirements for the explicit attribute, add that attribute to no_preference, and remove typed exclusions for that same attribute.
operations.REPLACE: Represented as a destructive typed ADD: remove active requirements for the same explicit or singleton-detected attribute before adding the replacement.

state_transition.full_override: Retain the Phase 9 provenance rule that removes initial_explicit and initial_tentative requirements while preserving independently disclosed answer/free_text requirements; then apply eligible atoms.
state_transition.intent_version: Increment exactly once if the message performs any exclusion, clear, replacement, or full override; ordinary additions retain the existing version.
state_transition.question_state: asked_attributes and last_asked_attribute retain Phase 9 semantics. An untyped residual is not assigned to the last asked attribute unless the exact existing single-slot rule would type it.

bounds.bound_failure: Return exact Phase 9 without partial candidate state or candidate cache commit.
bounds.time: O(message characters times the fixed detector count), with no data-dependent catalog work.
bounds.additional_retained_state: Only additional bounded Requirement/excluded entries already represented by IntentState; no second session map or message history.

fallback_contract.exact_result: Return the exact immutable state produced by protected Phase 9 from the original state, original message, and turn.
conditions: unrecognized envelope where safe payload boundaries cannot be proven
unsafe negation scope or correction target
duplicate, overlapping, empty, malformed, or out-of-order spans
invalid operation, attribute, provenance, state invariant, or result
any candidate parsing or application exception

telemetry.forbidden_dimensions: No session, turn, scenario, category, attribute, value, text, profile, product, route, target, rank, score, outcome, or free-form key.

positive_cells: two and eight distinct typed slots
explicit labels with punctuation and conjunctions inside values
same-attribute alternatives that must remain exact baseline
mixed case, Unicode punctuation, whitespace, repeated values, and source order
initial explicit, initial tentative, clarification answer, ordinary follow-up, and full override provenance
negative_and_control_cells: positive then exclusion and exclusion then positive in one message
not-only, not-sure, no-less-than, double-negation, and without-a-doubt guards
attribute-specific no-preference mixed with an unrelated positive
same-slot replace, no-longer, now, and instead corrections
pronoun scaffolds with and without an antecedent
ambiguous correction target and unmatched residual preservation
state_cells: reset of one session without affecting another
asked, interrupted, answered, and cleared attributes
bounds_and_malformed_cells: overlapping spans, empty clauses, control-only clauses, invalid attributes, and invalid turns
integration_cells: fresh SEARCH after a ranking-relevant multi-slot change
exact REUSE when complete dependencies are unchanged
no reuse across positive, exclusion, clear, or correction changes
candidate parser fault returns exact baseline and is not cached as candidate success
recommendation, question, usage, IntentState, SlateState, and call equivalence on every baseline fallback
zero additional model, API, embedding, BM25, dense, document, Stage-A, profile, question, or slate calls per fresh search
synthetic_test_plan.baseline_equivalence: Every existing canonical and Phase 6 robust single-slot family plus at least 10,000 fixed-seed single-slot/malformed variants must produce exact Phase 9 state, dense query, lexical query, response, cache decision, and fixed health counters.
synthetic_test_plan.independent_oracle: A separately expressed reference transition must exhaust practical small operation partitions and at least 20,000 fixed-seed valid and malformed messages, with exact state, query, status, intent_version, and determinism checks.

dataset_protocol.representative: lowest original row ordinal per content fingerprint

statistics.per_session_utility: u=0.50*hit + 0.30*reciprocal_rank + 0.20*clip((11-first_hit_turn)/10,0,1), with miss reciprocal_rank=0 and first_hit_turn=11
statistics.paired_delta: candidate utility minus baseline utility for the same session
statistics.bootstrap: Within each scenario stratum, sample the observed number of paired deltas with replacement; concatenate strata and average.
statistics.lower_bound: Deterministic empirical 2.5th percentile using the sorted replicate at zero-based index floor(0.025*10000).
statistics.gate: The overall scenario-stratified 95% lower confidence bound is at least zero on development, validation, and public confirmation.
statistics.hit_transition_check: Report aggregate both-hit, candidate-only-hit, baseline-only-hit, and both-miss counts; baseline-only-hit must be zero. Compute a fixed exact two-sided McNemar/binomial p-value for disclosure, not as a substitute for the zero-regression gate.

preconditions: validation and public attempt sentinels absent
suite_order: deduplicated sealed synthetic validation if development passes
released public confirmation if validation passes
execution.thermal_rule: Do not begin the next heavy suite while macOS reports thermal pressure. A consumed one-shot suite is never restarted because observation or cooling is slow.
execution.crash_safety: Create an exclusive per-suite attempt sentinel before loading that suite; interruption consumes that suite attempt.
